posts.name: nickel
posts.ig_caption:
Should the nickel go next?

A nickel costs 13.78 cents to make. A dime 5.76. A quarter 14.68. The penny cost 3.69, and the last circulating one was struck in Nov 2025.

Source: U.S. Mint 2024 Annual Report (fiscal 2024); St. Louis Fed.
Footage: Pexels. Not financial advice. Buck is our original character.

posts.name: ten_bill
posts.ig_caption:
Which bill do you hold onto longest?

The $10 wears out first: about 5.7 years. The $1 lasts about 7.2 years. The $100 about 24, because it mostly sits in drawers. And it's not paper: 75% cotton, 25% linen.

Source: Federal Reserve lifespan estimates; Bureau of Engraving and Printing.
Footage: Pexels. Not financial advice. Buck is our original character.

posts.ig_caption:
Why is a dollar called a buck? 🦌 Probably because of deerskins.

In 1748 a frontier trader wrote that he was robbed of "300 bucks" — 44 years before the U.S. dollar existed (1792). Historians still argue about it.

Sources: Merriam-Webster, Britannica; Coinage Act of 1792.
